notes.title: Quick fix: Bypassing tutorial
notes.content: - Bypasses tutorial because it is currently not working and freezes at first upgrade selection (which means that players can't finish the tutorial either, locking them out of the main game)

notes.title: Update to milestone branch 2 (December 2024)
notes.content:
Playtest build is now up to date with the latest milestone branch.
New features include (but are not limited to):
- More detailed encounter maps with all-new story encounters
- New final boss
- New third and 4th biome
- Gameplay tweaks and general stability improvements
